title: ChapterJobEvent
description: data of the SSE events a chapter or beat writing job sends between the lifecycle ones (§16); the SSE event name is the type.

beat_start.title: BeatStartEvent
beat_start.description: event: beat_start. The beat's text starts from nothing; sent again when the beat is written over (a banned phrase) or shown again as it is kept (a continuation of a short beat that was not kept as it was streamed).

sentence.title: SentenceEvent
sentence.description: event: sentence. The next piece of the beat's text, ending after a sentence or a line break; the pieces joined are the text as it arrived.

beat_done.title: BeatDoneEvent
beat_done.description: event: beat_done. The beat's text was stored as this version.

chars.description: Characters incl. spaces, counted in code; line breaks are not counted.

state_update.title: StateUpdateEvent
state_update.description: event: state_update. A state record the beat's check stored (§7).

warning.title: WarningEvent
warning.description: event: warning. A warning stored on the beat's new version.

beat_checked.title: BeatCheckedEvent
beat_checked.description: event: beat_checked. The beat's check is over (also when it failed: a check_failed warning came before it); warnings = the warnings on the beat's new version.
